title: Zacatecas Silver Mine Strike Ends After Wage Deal Reached
content: The two-week strike at the Zacatecas silver-lead mine has ended after the operator and union agreed to a wage increase, the company confirmed Tuesday. Production is expected to ramp back to full capacity within days. The operator estimated the stoppage cost roughly 400,000 ounces of forgone silver output, a modest dent in the mine's annual production.
